Submit MSC World Europa MSC World Europa Discover more Unveiling MSC World Europa Scroll down IntroItinerariesMain FeaturesEntertainment Restaurants & BuffetBars & LoungesCruise DealsMSC Yacht ClubSignature DesignVirtual TourDeckplansRelated ships Find a cruise MSC World Europa Welcome to The Future of Cruising Imagine the future of cruising and discover it in the revolutionary MSC World Class fleet. Entering service in 2022, MSC World Europa was the first ship in this trailblazing new generation. With their futuristic silhouette, signature plumb bow and Y-shaped aft, the ships in the MSC World class will looks like nothing else at sea, cutting through the water with ease and grace. To complete this revolution, we have also developed an immersive guest experience, so on MSC World Europa, guests can look forward to a holiday like no other. It’s a new class of emotions, for the future of cruising. ITINERARIES Discover a world of destinations Book your MSC World Europa cruise in the Mediterranean for summer 2026 and 2027. During winter 2026-27 the ship will sail to the Antilles. 5 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 19 April '26 to 24 April '26MediterraneanPrice per person from: €477Book this cruise6 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 08 November '26 to 14 November '26MediterraneanPrice per person from: €903Book this cruise7 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 01 November '26 to 08 November '26MediterraneanPrice per person from: €1,059Book this cruise7 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 26 April '27 to 03 May '27MediterraneanPrice per person from: €1,119Book this cruise19 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 20 November '27 to 09 December '27MSC Grand VoyagesPrice per person from: €1,551Book this cruise21 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 20 November '27 to 11 December '27MSC Grand VoyagesPrice per person from: €1,723Book this cruise23 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 20 November '27 to 13 December '27MSC Grand VoyagesPrice per person from: €1,895Book this cruise21 NIGHTS on MSC World EuropaFrom: GenoaDEPARTURE: 14 November '26 to 05 December '26MSC Grand VoyagesPrice per person from: €2,293Book this cruise See all MSC World Europa Cruises MAIN FEATURES Highlights of MSC World Europa Ground-breaking design From her stunning silhouette to her signature plumb bow, the futuristic MSC World Europa is as visually striking as she is innovative. Her unique Y-shaped open aft leads to the 104m long outdoor World Promenade, with incredible panoramic ocean views. The promenade also features the record breaking, longest dry slide at sea – the Venom Drop @ The Spiral – an 11-deck high stainless-steel masterpiece, unique in the cruise industry. Futuristic cruise experience MSC World Europa was designed to elevate the delights of a traditional cruise ship to entirely new levels. From her sleek interior design to her 13 dining venues to her thrilling entertainment offerings, the onboard experience is like no other cruise ship. Relax in the scenic Panorama Lounge, experience the excitement of the futuristic Luna Park Arena, or lose yourself in the iconic LED dome in the indoor World Galleria. On-board experience There’s something for everyone on board MSC World Europa. From the largest waterpark in our fleet, to bumper cars, and our new surprise street performances.And with 7 swimming pools spread across the ship, including one with a sliding roof, there’s always space to relax by the water and pool deck. For families with children, the award-winning MSC kids club features state-of-the-art facilities inside a dedicated area of the ship, with a range of kids’ clubs and tailor-made programs for every age group. MSC Aurea Spa Restore body and soul in the MSC Aurea Spa large 1012 m2, a luxurious Balinese spa on board on MSC World Europa. Comprising a thermal area, MSC Gym Powered by Technogym®, Beauty salon and Barber shop, it offers a wealth of wellness and beauty treatments to relax, pamper and revitalise you. ENTERTAINMENT A world of onboard fun awaits The onboard entertainment offers huge variety and choice for everyone. Panorama Lounge Discover moreopens in a new tab World Galleria Discover moreopens in a new tab World Theatre Discover moreopens in a new tab Aurora Borealis Aquapark Discover moreopens in a new tab Botanic Pool Garden Discover moreopens in a new tab Doremiland Discover moreopens in a new tab RESTAURANTS & BUFFET Discover our finest cruise dining The ship features 13 dining venues, including an incredible six speciality restaurants, between which the Chef’s Garden Kitchen of Michelin-starred chef Niklas Ekstedt, that offers a menu which focus on the natural ingredients and a farm-to-ocean ethos. Guests also have the opportunity to discover three ample restaurant-buffets on board, each offering their distinct ambiance, including a brand-new location open 24/7. RESTAURANT & BUFFET Chef’s Garden Kitchen Get insired by our menu*: See our pdfopens in a new tab The Chef’s Garden Kitchen’s promises fresh and seasonal flavours, taking its cues from nature. Born in Sweden, the son of a produce seller, Niklas Ekstedt began his strong connection with nature and the Earth’s flavours at a young age. Modernising cuisine with art not technology, Ekstedt combines traditional Nordic cooking and preserving techniques with astonishingly creative combinations of rigorously fresh seasonal ingredients. Peruse her decks, step into the fresh Zest – Juice Bar, settle in for a cup of tea at the Raj Polo Tea House or enjoy a cocktail at the Elixir - Mixology Bar. Bars and lounges will surprise guests with a strong focus on artisan and craft products. Award-winning brewmaster Teo Musso, who created the Baladin Farm Brewery, has worked with MSC Cruises to create a bespoke range of MSC signature craft beers that will be brewed at sea in the ship’s full-scale micro-brewery. BARS & LOUNGES The Lanai Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Let time float by, savouring the moment’s choice of wide selection of whiskies and classic whiskey cocktails, masterfully mixed from superior spirits. Relaxing on plush settees in an elegant club ambience, you’ll feel transported to a timeless realm of pure indulgence, inviting the temptation of a premium cigar. Make your choice from an extensive collection, carefully kept at the perfect temperature and humidity. You can even have us treat it to a brandy mist to further enhance the flavour. Then linger in the moment, rounding it out with select accompaniments. BARS & LOUNGES Luna Park Arena Pizza & Burger Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Our Luna Park Arena offers a wide choice of meticulously selected aperitifs, cocktails, spirits and more! Apéritif is a French word, which, like its Italian counterpart, aperitivo, comes from the Latin aperire, meaning ‘to open’. The idea behind aperitif is that your appetite is stimulated before a meal. Nowadays, aperitifs are enjoyed at any time and with our handpicked carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From traditional aperitifs, our Signature Cocktails to the contemporary classics, there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. BARS & LOUNGES Tv Studio & Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Entertainment hits a new level in our TV Studio & Bar. Broadcasting live throughout the ship, our TV Studio and radio suite air live games, quizzes, talent contests and other fun content, it also serves as an atmospheric comedy club, karaoke bar and live music venue. Soak up the atmosphere as we broadcast live or join in and unleash your inner star. An excellent selection of cocktails, beer, wine and soft drinks are available to get you ready for your big performance. BARS & LOUNGES MSC Signature Casino Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Get that James Bond feeling, order a drink from our skilled bar tenders and cast an eye over the Casino as you contemplate where lady luck will go to next. We have a wide variety of selected cocktails, mocktails, beer, wine and fine spirits to refresh yourself with as you take a break from play. BARS & LOUNGES Dolce Vita Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Apéritif is a French word, which, like its Italian counterpart, aperitivo, comes from the Latin aperire, meaning ‘to open’. The idea behind aperitif is that your appetite is stimulated before a meal. Nowadays, aperitifs are enjoyed at any time and with our handpicked carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From traditional aperitifs, our Signature Cocktails to the contemporary classics, there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. BARS & LOUNGES Panorama Lounge (Aft Bar) Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. This bar’s got it all! An elegant lounge with stunning aft views, an entertainment venue with stage and drinks that can still steal the limelight. Tickle your fancy with a selection of refreshing cocktails, wine, beer, cider and more, together with alcohol-free options including coffee and tea. BARS & LOUNGES Elixir - Mixology Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Buzzing with a bright, minimalistic ambience that fills each glass with sparkling light, this temple of Mediterranean mixology is the ideal meeting place to kick off an evening’s fun. But you may well find you linger for longer, tempted and tempted again by the scintillating array of fresh modern cocktail classics. Enticing you further, our expert mixologists and guest famous names specialise in inventing sensational cocktail creations, crafted specially to delight your tastes and mood. Using premium spirits and fresh fruit, plus just-picked herbs and garnishes grown hydroponically in the Chef’s Garden Kitchen next door, the results are an unforgettable explosion of flavours. The experience can be life changing. Elixir by name and elixir by nature! BARS & LOUNGES Sweet Temptations Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. A sweet heaven for real fruit gelato and frozen yoghurt, crepes, waffles, sublime shakes, angelic toppings and a build-your-own station for total indulgence. For divine pleasures, this is the place to be! Every colourful corner simply sings indulgence. Treat family, friends and of course yourself to a divine choice of sumptuous ice creams, fresh fruit gelatos, frozen yoghurt and more – finished with a massive rainbow choice of toppings. Crepes and waffles bring warm contrast to your heaven, while a traditional ice cream stand lets you take sweet trips down memory lane. But for truly special, lingering moments, step up to the build-your-own station to create exactly the extravagant combinations you desire. You can even build your own Magnum just how you’ve always wanted! BARS & LOUNGES Coffee Emporium Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Explore the amazing contrasts between different blends of premium coffee, selected for their quality by coffee masters Lavazza. There’s even a wild bean from the Kafa forests of Ethiopia where coffee began! Add depth to the experience with a learning journey to discover more about what you’re drinking, from the beans themselves to the influence of altitude, terroir and cleaning and drying technique. A selection of choice pastries and biscuits complete the pleasure. Explore, experience and share the joy with your friends! BARS & LOUNGES Fizz - Champagne Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. It is said that Dom Pérignon, monk and cellar master attributed to the discovery of champagne, stated upon his first taste of it - ‘Come quickly, I am tasting the stars!’. Certainly, fine champagne and sparkling wines are charismatic, and have a touch of heaven about them. Our carefully chosen and wide selection of fine champagnes, sparkling wines and champagne cocktails will tantalise your palate. To ensure we have only the best, we have painstakingly researched the quality of our sparkling wines and sourced them from the most renowned producers world-wide. To complement our fine selection of sparkling wines, we have chosen a delectable medley of exquisite seafood to tempt and tease your taste buds. Fresh oysters, shrimps, crab, clams and mussels are prepared to order in front of you by our talented chefs. For the traditionalist, there is, of course, the classic pairing of caviar and fine champagne, a match made in heaven, to spoil yourself with. BARS & LOUNGES Jean-Philippe Chocolat & Cafè Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. ...where enticingly sweet delights are created just for you in our unique open concept chocolate kitchen. Crowned the Best Pastry Chef in France, this renowned chocolatier has handcrafted a chocolate experience that the whole family will enjoy. As well as choosing from a variety of exquisite Chef created chocolate candies, guests can also create their very own chocolate bar right at the tablet stations. They will be able to handpick from a wide variety of delicious chocolate flavours and toppings. Treat someone you love to our unique house-made gelato or sorbet. Jean-Philippe Maury’s award-winning gelato is made on the premises, using only the finest quality ingredients and fresh fruit purees. The vanilla-flavoured waffle cones are baked on site, and are hand dipped in our chocolate fountain. It's the perfect place to enjoy a mouth-watering made-to-order crêpe, with your choice of delicious sweet or savoury fillings. BARS & LOUNGES Raj Polo Tea House Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Step into the elegance of the British Raj to enjoy the quintessential rites and flavours of Empire, all centred on the kingdom’s favourite drink: tea. You’ll find it served here in all its astonishing variety, from tea bags to loose-leaf speciality teas and blooming tea flowers. What’s more, you can be sure to find the perfect brew for every mood, including cold brewed and iced teas, tea-infused cocktails, tea digestive liqueurs, and countless other creative expressions of the art of tea. The wide selection ranges from authentic Earl Grey and Orange Pekoe, full-bodied Assam and muscatel Darjeeling to Spicy Chai and Floral Jasmine, herbal infusions, green teas, white teas and more. Painting a rich picture of Britain’s history of tea, they also tell the story of the East India Company, founded in 1600 during the reign of Queen Elizabeth I. But let’s not forget the food. You’ll dream about the food! All served in period style, it’s in an abundant class of its own, from full English breakfasts to Afternoon Teas with scones, strawberry jam and double clotted cream. Traditional High Tea is served from lunchtime through to late evening and is an altogether more lavish affair, both savoury and sweet, that simply has to be experienced! BARS & LOUNGES The Gin Project Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Enter a delicious world of history and creation in the Gin Project lounge, a chic grey-brick boutique venue that’s an encyclopaedia of gin infusions and cocktails just waiting to be explored and created. Sitting among vintage photographs of gin distilling and the equipment involved, relish the world’s finest gins and most astonishing gin cocktails. There’s nothing better than quaffable holiday memories you’ve created yourself! BARS & LOUNGES Botanic Garden Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Indulge in a lush poolside taste of Eden, refreshing body and soul with a heavenly choice of freshly made drinks, all prepared with premium ingredients, naturally! From Signature Cocktails and coladas to premium beers, soft drinks, coffee and tea, there’s something to bring everyone a paradise moment. BARS & LOUNGES Zen Pool Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Gaze out over the stunning panorama of the ocean while you sip on a cocktail at the Zen Bar. With our handpicked and carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From our Signature Cocktails to the contemporary classics of Daiquiri’s and Piña Colada’s there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. BARS & LOUNGES Top 20 Exclusive Solarium Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Enjoy that holiday feeling as you kick back and relax with a drink poolside. There is a wide variety of choice to choose from at the Top 20 exclusive Bar. From Signature Cocktails, beers, coladas, soft drinks, coffee and tea there is something to suit everyone’s taste. We carefully select our drinks and ingredients from the best producers to ensure that we offer only the best. BARS & LOUNGES Zest - Juice Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Zest up your life with fresh-pressed fruit and vegetable juices, smoothies, power shakes, fruit salads and quinoa fruit bowls. Here’s where to grab and go for everything from post workout refuelling to vitamin-packed hedonism and detox specials, including a 3-day custom cleanse programme. Watch it all being prepared freshly from scratch, then grab and go and…. glow! BARS & LOUNGES The Box Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Enjoy the atmosphere of the big game in our unique The Box Bar. The wide and varied choice of cocktails that we carefully selected are sure to quench even the strongest thirst. If you need something to keep you going through the game, you can always get one of our energy drinks. BARS & LOUNGES Rive Droit Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. The Rive Droit offers a heavenly array of ice cream and a wide variety of Signature Cocktails, beers, coladas, soft drinks, coffee and tea there is something to suit everyone’s taste. We carefully select our drinks and ingredients from the best producers to ensure that we offer only the best. Enjoy that holiday feeling as you kick back and relax with a drink poolside. There is a wide variety of choice to choose from at the Rive Droit. BARS & LOUNGES Surfers Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Vibrant fun for adults and children of all ages, this on-deck lounger bar is a perfect escape and meeting place. Add sparkle to any moment with its colourful cocktails and fabulous non-alcoholic long drinks, beers, soda floats and freestyle coke machine. When the temperature rises, you’ll love the authentic gelato ice cream in sugar waffle cones, zinged up with your choice of flavourful toppings. BARS & LOUNGES Top Sail Lounge Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Reserved exclusively for MSC Yacht Club Guests, this elegant lounge with its panoramic views offers the Yacht Club bar list of craft cocktails, beer, fine wine, soft drinks and coffee drinks. This elegant lounge equally offers a fine selection of gourmet finger food throughout the day. Enjoy spectacular views in this elegant lounge. BARS & LOUNGES MSC Yatch Club Suondeck & Bar Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. Surround yourself in the lap of luxury and let our artful bar tenders prepare something special for you! With our handpicked carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From our Signature Cocktails, contemporary classics of Daiquiri’s, Piña Colada’s to soft drinks, beers and hot drinks, there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. For the connoisseur there is a handpicked selection of premium drinks available. RESTAURANTS & BUFFET Hola! Tacos & Cantina Get inside by our menu*: see our menu. The new fast-casual street food dining concept, offers a selection of Latin American and Mexican-inspired dishes and drinks to be shared and enjoyed in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, open for lunch and dinner. Choose from a tantalising array of dishes from blue corn tacos and nachos, and tasty tamales through to tortilla soup or vegetarian tacos, all to be savoured with our selection of Top 10 Tequilas and Mezcals! RESTAURANTS & BUFFET Les Dunes Restaurant Get inside by our menu*: see our menu.
